text_block_list.text: After discussing the future with Mejiro Ramonu... while staying focused on training, the new year had already arrived.

Every year, the URA, which operates the Twinkle Series,
presents awards to Umamusume who achieved outstanding results.
Mejiro Ramonu was also—
Honored for her achievements in the Classic Year, she was selected as 'Best Classic Queen Umamusume'. On the day of the award ceremony—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems the pairing of you and me
has really become a permanent fixture.
—Symboli Rudolf was also set to receive a special award in recognition of all her hard work dedicated to racing over the past year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It's an exceptionally eye-catching advertisement, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Don't say that. The selection was based purely on results, and that hasn't changed."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Even so... being commended alongside you brings back old memories.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember? When we were kids,
at the national race, the 'Little Star Cup'...
We ran on different tracks back then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Both of us became champions of our respective courses,
and received our trophies side by side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Of course I remember.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It was back then that I... truly got to know the person you are.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The first time, huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...You haven't changed a bit since back then.
You're still just as single-minded and earnest."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It seems I'm not very good at disguising myself.
Perhaps I should take lessons from you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I can teach you anytime. However,
nothing could ever be quite as beautiful as you just being yourself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's because you are who you are
that I find myself seeking it from you.
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it, right after her debut—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And someday, I would love to work alongside you as equals.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Ramonu. I will always respect your will
and abide by it. However—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If you can stay true to yourself... and pour out that
overflowing love with an open mind."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—If you will stand beside me,
nothing could be more reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: For instance, what can be done to further enrich the Tiara route... The scenery painted from your perspective must be truly beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You don't have to give an answer right now.
Even if it takes an eternity, I will wait for you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's time for the award ceremony.
Allow me to offer you my heartfelt praise—
And so, the glamorous award ceremony began. Everything proceeded smoothly according to schedule, until at last, Mejiro Ramonu and Symboli Rudolf stood side by side.

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text: “—Now then, we'll begin by hearing from Mejiro Ramonu, who has been awarded 'Best Classic Queen Umamusume'.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
First and foremost, thank you very much
for bestowing such a glorious award upon me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I shall show you running worthy of this award
in the Senior year as well.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: The Senior Class too, huh... So those rumors about stepping back from the front lines were completely baseless after all.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I guess the future I'll build with the "Emperor"
is put on hold for just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Lastly, if I may take this opportunity...
there is someone I would like to say a few words to."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Rudolf.
(Murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Saying you will 'wait'...
Please don't say something so admirable."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I shall give it to you.
Right this instant."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
My wish is... of course,
to stand side-by-side with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —In a race, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Return to the turf, Rudolf.
If you are there, I will shower you with love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"As a single fragment
that manifests the supreme race."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: H-Hey... does this mean from Mejiro Ramonu to Symboli Rudolf—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
A declaration of war!?
Hey now, what kind of turn has this taken...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ramonu...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...So that is your answer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Truly, such a daydreamer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—That day. The day I stood beside you
and accepted the trophy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You smiled at me
with the casual ease of encountering a fellow hunter
from a different territory."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—And you were supposed to be
my prey, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You are a wonderful 'Umamusume.'
Flawless and perfect. That is why—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'll bring you to your knees.
Before perfect love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "You said that staying true to oneself is beautiful, did you not?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You would do well to watch me closely
from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You will definitely want to steal this love away...
Without fail."

Afterward, Symboli Rudolf tactfully calmed the restless venue,
and the awards ceremony managed to conclude.
However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What a troublesome person you are!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It probably made for better advertising.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, even the instructors are probably swamped with phone calls right about now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...However, Ramonu.
Even coming from an Umamusume of your caliber, it's impossible.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will not return there anymore.
That resolve of mine is far from frivolous.
After Symboli Rudolf left—
choice_data_list: ...Though it seems your resolve is quite firm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
No problem.
She will definitely show up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: After all, I am more of a beast than anyone.
choice_data_list: Doesn't look like it to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're quite young, aren't you?

"...Anyway, the main event is over.
We don't really have any plans after this, but..."
choice_data_list: Shall we call it a day?
I want to do some race research.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I've chattered on for too long.
I must calm the waves.

Mejiro Ramonu seemed to have gotten plenty of rest,
as she looked refreshed when I saw her the next day—
or so it felt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Feels like today...
I can really let loose and run...

Perhaps sharing what was on her mind cleared her head...
During the subsequent training, Mejiro Ramonu
displayed a brilliantly sharp running performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Very well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: The Victoria Mile, the Takarazuka Kinen, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, the Japan Cup... I leave them in your care.

And so, we moved over to the Trainer's office
and watched past footage together
of the upcoming Senior Class races.
